scope: Build-gated single-member development admission and disposable success/failure HUD cinematics

domain.coverage: Explicit solo arena/roster opt-in, invalid counts and stale identity, manual Ready, same-tick solo AllParticipantsDowned, two-player workload, full scores with 1/2/3/4 members, result expiry/reset/outsiders/cancel

compiled_codec.coverage: Preparation/Ready and all score descriptors, bounded counts/epochs, malformed/truncated payloads, shared-buffer boundaries and retained recovery/grid fields

deployment.scope: Baseline/deployed hash-guarded changes only; previous packages backed up, no deletions

runtime.note: User-owned GUI and friend remains default; no process launch, invulnerability, NPC, save or Mod-list change

limitations: Solo admission is not a balanced public solo mode
Solo cannot establish multiplayer sync, revival, latency or party balance
Other Mods may cancel normal Terraria death or draw their own post-interface HUD; live interaction is unmeasured
Public release must compile the solo flag off and verify actual one-player rejection
Reused art/audio have no new human acceptance claim
